title: Extract the desktop transport contract from the live desktop invoke surface
description: Split the 5 live Tauri commands `[get_gateway_base, set_gateway_base_override, start_backend, check_backend_health, call_api]`, 1 generic request envelope, and the runtime-base resolution path out of the current desktop invoke surface into a dedicated transport contract layer while preserving the existing Rust host behavior in `desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs`.

criteria: `desktop/src/api/client.ts` no longer owns the Tauri command-name literals or the generic invoke or fetch transport envelope.
1 desktop transport contract layer exists and is the single source for the 5 live Tauri commands, HTTP method types, request envelope, and base normalization or runtime-base helpers.

0 raw command-name string usages remain outside the transport contract across `desktop/src/api/client.ts`, `desktop/src/hooks/useAppBackendBootstrap.ts`, and `desktop/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx`.
`desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs` still exposes the same 5 commands and matches the extracted contract naming without adding new runtime branches.
convergence.verification: npm --prefix desktop run typecheck && npm --prefix desktop run test -- src/api/client.test.ts && cargo check --manifest-path desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml
convergence.definition_of_done: The desktop frontend-to-host transport seam is explicit, importable, and behavior-preserving, and future client work can depend on the extracted transport layer instead of editing inline Tauri literals in `client.ts`.

implementation.title: Inventory the current transport seam
implementation.description: Map the current base-resolution helpers, cached runtime-base logic, generic `callApi` bridge, and the 5 live Tauri command usages inside `desktop/src/api/client.ts`, `desktop/src/hooks/useAppBackendBootstrap.ts`, `desktop/src/components/SettingsModal.tsx`, and `desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs`.

implementation.title: Create the desktop transport contract layer
implementation.description: Extract shared command constants, request-envelope types, and transport helpers into dedicated desktop API files, then update `client.ts` and the other live invoke call sites to consume them instead of defining command names inline.

implementation.title: Align the Rust host with the extracted contract
implementation.description: Keep `main.rs` command registration behavior unchanged while aligning its command documentation and handler signatures with the extracted transport contract so the seam is explicit on both sides.

notes: Keep the desktop runtime path stable while splitting the transport seam out of `client.ts`.
Do not change gateway behavior, sidecar packaging, or command names in this task.
